description: This Java class 'Table2D' extends 'TableWithData' and implements a 2D table with axis and data handling, including functionalities like copying, pasting, interpolating, comparison, and GUI rendering within a software project related to tuning and data analysis.

classes.name: Table2D
classes.description: Represents a 2D table with axis and data, providing methods for data manipulation, GUI interaction, comparison, and clipboard operations.

methods.name: getAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis object associated with the 2D table.

methods.name: setAxis
methods.description: Sets the axis object for the table.

methods.name: populateCompareValues
methods.description: Populates comparison values from another Table2D instance.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes the comparison display.

methods.name: getTableAsString
methods.description: Returns the table data and axis as a formatted string.

methods.name: getFrameSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the display size of the table UI component.

methods.name: populateTable
methods.description: Loads byte array data into the table structure, including axis and data cells.

methods.name: updateTableLabel
methods.description: Updates the label showing the current scale or name of the axis.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears selected cells on the table and axis.

methods.name: setRevertPoint
methods.description: Sets the current state as a revert point for undo operations.

methods.name: undoAll
methods.description: Reverts all changes to the last revert point.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the table data into a byte array for saving.

methods.name: addKeyListener
methods.description: Adds a KeyListener to the table and axis for keyboard interactions.

methods.name: cursorUp
methods.description: Moves the cursor up, selecting corresponding axis cell if applicable.

methods.name: drawTable
methods.description: Renders the table and axis visually.

methods.name: cursorDown
methods.description: Moves the cursor down in the axis.

methods.name: cursorLeft
methods.description: Moves the cursor left either in data or axis.

methods.name: cursorRight
methods.description: Moves the cursor right either in data or axis.

methods.name: startHighlight
methods.description: Begins cell highlighting at specified coordinates.

methods.name: copySelection
methods.description: Copies the selected cell(s) to clipboard, then initiates background worker for copying.

methods.name: copyTable
methods.description: Copies the entire table to clipboard via background worker.

methods.name: paste
methods.description: Pastes data from clipboard, handling different formats including tables and selections.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Performs interpolation on table data and axis.

methods.name: verticalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs vertical interpolation.

methods.name: horizontalInterpolate
methods.description: Performs horizontal interpolation.

methods.name: isLiveDataSupported
methods.description: Returns whether live data import is supported for the axis.

methods.name: isButtonSelected
methods.description: Indicates if button controls are active.

methods.name: clearLiveDataTrace
methods.description: Clears live data traces in the table and axis.

methods.name: updateLiveDataHighlight
methods.description: Updates highlight based on live data overlay.

methods.name: getLogParamString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of log parameters for the axis and table.

methods.name: setOverlayLog
methods.description: Enables or disables overlay logging, affecting axis.

methods.name: setCompareDisplay
methods.description: Sets comparison display mode and propagates to axis.

methods.name: setCompareValueType
methods.description: Sets comparison value type and propagates to axis.

methods.name: setCurrentScale
methods.description: Sets the current scale for the axis, considering application settings.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another Table2D object based on name, axis, and data.

methods.name: repaint
methods.description: Triggers a repaint of the table and axis components.
